verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents identity overrides that set feature flag state for specific individual users ("identities"), explicitly for internal testing, QA and customer support. It also documents segment overrides for groups and markets segments for releasing features to beta testers. An override can enable or disable a flag for a named user, which covers both targeting and excluding. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-user exclusion and bulk ID-list allowlists, depth on how overrides are managed at scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: Override feature flags for individual users ("identities"). Enables internal testing, QA, customer support, or personalised experiences at the user level.
Segments: Release features to beta testers, collect feedback, and iterate
use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
